obfuscation_indicators: beyond management’s ability to control or predict
risk_summary: The disclosure provides meaningful quantitative results but emphasizes significant uncertainty around affordability, interest rates, construction delays, elevated costs, demand, and potential impairment charges. Profitability declined substantially year over year, while unusually favorable prior-year tax and pension items complicate comparability. Extensive forward-looking disclaimers and conditional language limit visibility into future operating performance.
